samples.text: Yet it also raises challenges for the future of work and for human rights and fundamental freedoms. This calls for international governance that places the human being with his or her freedom and privacy at the heart of this transformation. Above all, we must not allow an artificial intelligence divide to emerge on top of the existing gaps in wealth and development. Restoring trust requires that every individual feel that the law protects them, that development do not exclude them, and that progress leaves no one behind. Mr. President, if restoring trust is a challenge facing our world today, for Lebanon, it is not a mere slogan. Just as managing transformation is not an option up for debate. Together, they constitute the very essence of the mission we pledged before our people, before our Arab brothers, and before the entire world on the day I was entrusted with leading the government of Lebanon. We assumed this responsibility at a time when our country faced three existential challenges. The first was to regain the trust of its people after the financial collapse and the Beirut port explosion and the tragedies and wounds they left behind. The second was to reclaim its national decision-making, so that no authority stands above that of the state, no weapons exist outside its armed forces, and no decision on war and peace is taken outside its constitutional institutions. The third was to recover all of its territory from Israeli occupation and to extend its sovereignty over the entirety of its national soil through its own forces in implementation of the Taif Agreement and in sincere respect for the relevant international resolutions on Lebanon. Foremost among these is Resolution 1701, which remains to this day a fundamental point of reference governing relations between Lebanon and Israel. Trust rebuilt, decision-making reclaimed, land liberated, that is the equation for Lebanon's recovery. These are not three separate challenges. They are three facets of a single cause. Restoring a state that its citizens trust, that is master of its own decisions, and that exercises sovereignty over the whole of its territory.
